snippet.title: Cards & Cannons - Gameplay Trailer | Summer Games Fest
snippet.description:
👑⚔️Wishlist Cards & Cannons: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4536920/Cards__Cannons/

Build epic realms to churn through unimaginable enemy hordes in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Collect shiny loot, stack up mighty spells, and develop crazy synergies as you defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world. You call the shots in this colorful medieval madness. Your deck. Your strategy. Your chaos. How far can you push it? Gigabrain tactics? Glorious failure? Doesn't matter - run it back!

A Game by Flamehead Games | Nominated for the German Videogame Awards (DCP) – Newcomer Award Best Prototype

#IndieGames #Roguelite #TowerDefense #Deckbuilder
